comparison.objective: Set solar-row spacing, versus adjust and verify a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Measure and position large row elements versus small recessed-tool insertion, fine collar rotation, bimanual stabilization, and lock torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Required row spacing is title-implied; no body/specs or tolerance is available. Candidate requires two safe repeatable dynamic stops and bounded collar drift.
comparison.reason: Large-scale spatial layout is a different tested outcome from commissioning a dynamic energy absorber.
